CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database
Subject 143, trial 03: Start to Run, captured at 120 Hz.

Source files, retrieved 2026-10-01:
https://mocap.cs.cmu.edu/subjects/143/143.asf
https://mocap.cs.cmu.edu/subjects/143/143_03.amc

The skeleton retains its original measurements and hierarchy.
Text whitespace is normalized; the parsed skeleton is unchanged.

CMU usage statement:
"The motion capture data may be copied, modified, or redistributed without permission."
https://mocap.cs.cmu.edu/faqs.php

The database does not guarantee data quality. Joint endpoints do not establish
shoe contact or ground reaction forces. Review the retargeted motion in full.
